_about: Realistic legitimate messages an elderly WhatsApp user receives (family, friends, banks, delivery, clinics, government, utilities, forwarded anti-scam warnings) in Cantonese, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, English and mixed text. Every row is legitimate: any archive or block is a false positive. Phone numbers, OTPs and order numbers are made up. Run: node scripts/legit-fpr.js
